WHAT THE F*CK IS THIS?? 🤯

A HUGE library of 1,270+ design-md files collected from real websites that you can use with your AI agents to build beautiful UIs inspired by actual websites.

Simply pick any website design you like, grab its design-md file, and give it to Claude Code, Codex or Cursor.

Your AI agent can then use those design guidelines to build interfaces inspired by that website's visual style.

It's completely FREE and doesn't even require a signup.

What a fantastic way to build next-level websites using AI :))
